tvShow.name: The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon
tvShow.overview: After washing ashore in France, Daryl struggles to piece together how he got there and why, as he navigates a fractured, walker-infested landscape to find his way home. During his journey, Daryl has to protect a young boy, Laurent, who is seen as a messiah, while facing new, dangerous walker variants and the "Power of the Living" paramilitary group, as the connections he forms along the way complicate his plan to return home.

episodes.name: L'âme Perdue
episodes.overview: Daryl Dixon's arrival in France puts a young boy under the care of nuns in danger.

episodes.name: Alouette
episodes.overview: Daryl, Isabelle, Laurent, and Sylvie face trouble on the road. Isabelle remembers the day the hungry ones appeared. Laurent struggles to fit in.

episodes.name: Paris sera toujours Paris
episodes.overview: The group arrives in Paris, where Isabelle confronts her past while growing closer to Daryl. Codron seeks help from the leader of a growing nationalist movement called Pouvoir, putting the Union of Hope and Laurent under dangerous scrutiny.

episodes.name: La Dame de Fer
episodes.overview: Daryl and Isabelle must negotiate with Quinn, the proprietor of the underground Demimonde club - the last vestige of art and expression in Paris.

episodes.name: Deux Amours
episodes.overview: Daryl faces old demons, recalling the circumstances that landed him in France. Isabelle's sacrifice forces her to consider drastic measures. Genet commences a celebration for the people of Paris.

episodes.name: Coming Home
episodes.overview: Genet solidifies her base of power. Before Daryl can return to America, he has a job to do.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Following his departure from The Commonwealth, Daryl Dixon washes ashore in France, raising the ire of a splintered but growing autocratic movement centered in Paris and endangering a young boy at the heart of a benevolent religious movement.

episodes.name: The Book of Carol: La gentillesse des étrangers
episodes.overview: Carol maps a path toward Daryl. Daryl, Isabelle, and Laurent define their roles at the Nest.

episodes.name: The Book of Carol: Moulin Rouge
episodes.overview: Carol and Ash take an unexpected detour. Daryl and Isabelle uncover a new threat at the Nest.

episodes.name: The Book of Carol: L'invisible
episodes.overview: Carol hunts for information. Daryl and Isabelle race to save one of their own. Pouvoir regroups.

episodes.name: The Book of Carol: Le Paradis Pour Toi
episodes.overview: All hope feels lost amidst Genet's attack on the Nest.

episodes.name: The Book of Carol: Vouloir, C'est Pouvoir
episodes.overview: A new faction of survivors hunt down Laurent. Carol's lies come to a head.

episodes.name: The Book of Carol: Au Revoir Les Enfants
episodes.overview: An exit strategy is charted from France.

seasons.name: The Book of Carol
seasons.overview: Season two follows Daryl Dixon and Carol Peletier as they both confront old demons while she fights to find her friend and he struggles with his decision to stay in France, causing tension at the Nest. Additionally, Genet's movement builds momentum, setting Pouvoir on a violent collision course with the Union of Hope in the fight for France's future.

episodes.name: Costa da Morte
episodes.overview: A chance encounter provides a potential way home; Daryl makes a tough decision.

episodes.name: La Ofrenda
episodes.overview: Shipwrecked in Spain, Daryl and Carol seek refuge in a peaceful village.

episodes.name: El Sacrificio
episodes.overview: Daryl focuses on getting home while Carol gets more invested in Solaz.

episodes.name: La Justicia Fronteriza
episodes.overview: Daryl and Carol disagree on how to move forward. A surprise attack changes everything.

episodes.name: Limbo
episodes.overview: Carol helps Antonio and Roberto while Daryl journeys into the desert in search of someone.

episodes.name: Contrabando
episodes.overview: Daryl and Paz in Barcelona. Carol and Antonio face the fallout of Solaz.

episodes.name: Solaz del Mar
episodes.overview: Our heroes fight to protect the people they love.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Season three follows Daryl Dixon and Carol Peletier as they continue their journey to somehow return home and to the ones they love. As they struggle to find their way back, the path takes them farther astray, leading them through distant lands with ever-changing and unfamiliar conditions as they witness the various effects of the Walker apocalypse.

reviews.author: Dani
reviews.content: I actually just started watching the original Walking Dead Series about a week ago I'm not a huge zombie fan but I did start the new spinoff Darryl Dixon and I actually think it's better than the original. Just watched the second episode today and it's great I would definitely recommend it even if you haven't seen all the others this series is still worth watching

reviews.author: MovieGuys
reviews.content:
Daryl Dixon started off better than other Walking Dead spin offs but is let down by unconvincing and at times, downright silly, storytelling.

Whilst this series set the stage nicely for a European take on the WD saga, the second episode demonstrated writing that felt like it was better suited to an episode of "The Famous Five". Episode three is no better, with the whole proposition reduced to a gaudy, side show. 

The simple lack of plausibility and realism, the lack of any true sense of desperation, works against any notion that this is a hard nosed, post apocalyptic series, that takes itself seriously.  

In summary, the writing needs to get back on track, if this series wants to engage with an adult audience. That said, after three episodes I doubt it will. I'm well and truly out.
